text:
Priya: Hey team, I'm in Porto for a 2-day visit and need quick breakfast spots near the riverside (near Ribeira) and a casual dinner place with vegetarian options for 6. Prefer places open early-ish for coffee/pastries. Any faves?

Noah: For breakfast, 'Padaria do Cais' has great bifanas and pastel de nata by 8am. Small place but super quick.

Gus: If you want a quieter spot, 'Café Bar Flores' opens at 7:30, nice pour-overs and almond croissants. Good wifi too.

Leah: For dinner, 'Mercado do Sabor' is a food-hall-style spot near Ribeira. Lots of stalls, solid veggie tapas and big variety. Budget-friendly for a group.

Marta: Also 'Casa da Coura' (a 7-min walk) has a big vegetable stew and sharing plates, friendly for groups of 6. Call to reserve a table.

Priya: Any of these deliver to an Airbnb if I need to eat in?

Noah: Mercado vendors sometimes do delivery via local apps, but better to get takeaway boxes. Casa da Coura does takeout until 10pm.

Gus: Quick poll, emoji vote: 1) Mercado do Sabor (variety) :one:, 2) Casa da Coura (sit-down) :two:, 3) Padaria + picnic by the river (low-effort) :three:

Leah: :one: for variety and people-pleasing.

Marta: :two: if you want a proper table.

Noah: :three: for the morning recs, cheap and lovely views.

Priya: Looks like Mercado wins for dinner. Anyone have a quick booking link or phone?

Gus: No booking link, but here's their page: https://example.porto/mercado-do-sabor — usually walk-in, but for 6 you might arrive early or split into two tables.

ExpenseBot: Reminder: per-diem meals under 25 EUR are auto-approved. Keep receipts and tag with #travel-porto.

Priya: Thanks all! I'll aim for pastries at Padaria do Cais in the morning and Mercado do Sabor for dinner on Wed. Ping me if you want to join. :)
